# Images Directory

Place your personal profile photos, avatar, project previews, and site graphics in this folder.

### Recommended Files:
- `profile.jpg` or `profile.png` - Your professional profile portrait photo (placed in hero and about section).
- `project-1.jpg`, `project-2.jpg`, etc. - Project screenshots or thumbnails.

Update `src/data/portfolioData.js` to link to your image filenames (e.g. `/images/profile.jpg`).
